integrity: The lower bounds and equality cases are exhaustive finite results. Two independent enumerators reproduce the complete overlap-free languages through length 14 and the same Hamming-isolation profiles. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only the first two generalized levels beyond ordinary delicacy, namely k=2 and k=3. It does not settle the all-k existence question or give a formula for larger k.
title: Sharp first generalized-delicacy thresholds for binary overlap-free words
